body:
## Summary

Wires the guest post in GitHub Discussion [#46](https://github.com/orgs/augmented-mind/discussions/46) (CongJie Pan — _The Human Measure_) into the website as a new **Guest Posts** content type, connected to Episode 01 in Graph View.

- **Dedicated section**: new `content/guest-posts/` with an index page and the converted post. Surfaced via a sidebar list and a landing-page carousel, mirroring Episodes/Livestreams.
- **Author-highlighted page**: `quartz/components/pages/Content.tsx` renders a guest-post header (a `Guest Post` badge, the title, and a byline linking to the author's site) that reuses the episode page's card chrome but spotlights the external author rather than a team member. `quartz.layout.ts` suppresses the default title/meta for these pages, and `custom.scss` extends the episode card styling to `guest-posts/`.
- **Graph View**: the post links to `[[ep01]]`, which resolves to an internal link, so the post node connects to Episode 01 (with a matching backlink on the EP01 page).
- **Localized images**: the 4 hackmd.io images are downloaded into `quartz/static/guest-posts/the-human-measure/` and referenced by local path (no external hotlinks).
- **Repeatable workflow**: `scripts/import-guest-post.mjs` (`npm run import:guest-post <discussion#> [--slug ...] [--episode ep01]`) fetches a discussion via the GraphQL API, downloads its images, and scaffolds the markdown for review.

## Verification

- `quartz build` completes cleanly (84 files emitted); the post renders with the author header, no duplicate title, local image paths, and a bidirectional graph link to EP01.
- `tsc --noEmit` reports only the 7 pre-existing errors present on `main` (none introduced by this change); new files pass `prettier --check`.

## Notes

Defaults chosen in the absence of answers to the earlier planning questions: episode link → EP01 (the post explicitly references it); workflow → a manually-run importer script (no auto-publishing Action, to avoid review/safety concerns); author shown as an inline highlighted byline rather than a separate `people/` node. These are easy to adjust on request.

Closes #71

comments.body:
@sepo-agent /answer ok this seems to be a good starting point. 

I am thinking about perhaps slightly different direction: 
1. can we directly render the content from github (in a way similar to giscus)
2. all the routes can go to something like /forum and it can list the content dynamically 
3. we do not need to display the guest post on the main page.

Here's my read on the three asks, grounded in how the site actually builds and deploys.

## Context: this is a static site

The site is **Quartz (SSG)** — [`deploy.yml`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/.github/workflows/deploy.yml) runs `npx quartz build` on push to `main` and publishes `public/` to GitHub Pages. Routes are folders under [`content/`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/tree/main/content) (e.g. `episodes/`, `livestreams/`), and pages are generated at build time. There's no server at runtime.

That one fact drives everything below.

## 1. "Render directly from GitHub, like giscus"

Worth being precise about *why* giscus can do this: giscus is a **hosted GitHub App backend** (giscus.app) that the [`Comments`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz/components/Comments.tsx) widget loads as an iframe. The static page never touches the GitHub API itself.

A page on *our* static site can't replicate that for arbitrary post bodies, because client-side rendering of Discussions would need the GitHub GraphQL API at runtime, which means a token (can't be safely embedded in a public static bundle), plus rate limits (60/hr unauthenticated per IP) and CORS. So there are two honest models:

- **A — Build-time sync (recommended).** Discussions stay the source of truth; a step/Action fetches them via GraphQL and generates markdown into `content/forum/` *before* `quartz build`. "Dynamic" in the sense that the site auto-syncs from GitHub, but you keep Graph View, search, popovers, and SEO. This is essentially generalizing the importer already in this PR ([`scripts/import-guest-post.mjs`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/scripts/import-guest-post.mjs)) from manual → automatic.
- **B — Runtime client fetch (true giscus-style).** A `/forum` page whose JS calls GitHub at load time. Gets you "live" content but needs a hosted proxy/token to be safe, and loses the SSG benefits above (graph, search index, link resolution). Higher effort, more moving parts.

My recommendation is **A**: it satisfies "content comes from GitHub" and "lists dynamically" while staying inside the architecture that already exists.

## 2. Everything under `/forum`, listed dynamically

Straightforward under model A. Quartz already has [`FolderContent`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz/components/pages/FolderContent.tsx) which auto-lists a folder's children — so `content/forum/index.md` becomes the dynamic index for free, and each synced discussion lands at `/forum/<slug>`. We'd rename/move the guest-posts concept in this PR to `forum/`.

## 3. Don't show on the main page

Easy and independent of the above — drop the two index-page injections this PR adds in [`quartz.layout.ts`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz.layout.ts): the `guestPostsCarousel` `ConditionalRender` (and we'd reconsider whether the homepage `GuestSuggestion` still belongs).

## Proposed plan (pending your approval)

1. **Rename `guest-posts/` → `forum/`** across content, layout, `Content.tsx`, and `custom.scss`.
2. **Index page**: use `FolderContent` for `/forum` instead of the bespoke carousel; remove the landing-page carousel + sidebar injections so it's off the homepage (ask 3).
3. **Sync mechanism**: turn the manual importer into a scheduled GitHub Action (e.g. nightly + manual dispatch) that pulls a designated Discussions category into `content/forum/*.md`, downloads images locally (as it does now), and commits — which retriggers `deploy.yml`. Discussions stay the editable source of truth.
4. **Keep the per-post header/author chrome** already built in [`Content.tsx`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz/components/pages/Content.tsx); it works the same under `/forum`.
5. Graph linking (e.g. `[[ep01]]`) stays as-is.

A few questions before I touch code:

- **Which Discussions category** maps to `/forum`? (One dedicated category keeps the sync unambiguous.)
- **Sync cadence** — scheduled Action committing markdown (my rec), or are you actually after model B's runtime fetch despite the SSG tradeoffs?
- **Author → markdown**: auto-publish every post in the category, or keep a light review gate (e.g. a label like `approved`) before it syncs to the site?

If model A + these defaults look right, say the word and I'll restructure this PR accordingly.

---
`claude` | `claude-opus-4-8` | `high` | `GitHub Actions 1000001811`

title: Wire guest posts from Discussions into a dedicated section
